title: Constricting Tubes for Prescribed-Time Safe Control
summary: We propose a constricting Control Barrier Function (CBF) framework for prescribed-time control of control-affine systems with input constraints. Given a system starting outside a target safe set, we construct a time-varying safety tube that shrinks from a relaxed set containing the initial condition to the target set at a user-specified deadline. Any controller rendering this tube forward invariant guarantees prescribed-time recovery by construction.
